item.text:
For a non-empty topic, `get_relevant_context` uses **pure symbolic retrieval**: it asks the project KG’s `entity_index` for matching class instances (`search_classes`) and returns only hits above the `TOPIC_RELEVANCE_FLOOR` (`0.45`), with the caller limit clamped to `1..100`, then formats each result as a `ContextItem` (kind/label/literals/IRI) for output.  
No LLM is used in this path; it is an index lookup over existing graph records rather than free-text embedding/vector retrieval.
